paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.13, with a decrease of 4.3% from the prior close and an increase of 1.24% over a window of 22 sessions.

Recent news includes a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a $6.5B AI lease and $431M notes, and a 2.6 Gigawatt Power Strategic Alliance for Project Matador. Construction is also underway at Fermi America's Project Matador Campus.

There have been various SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. There has been one Form 4 filing and five new social posts in the last 24 hours.
